svg.title: KAUO pavement geometry over USGS NAIP 2023 imagery
svg.desc: ALDOT pavement polygons, FAA runway axes, and MEDIUM-confidence OSM candidate taxiway centerlines are transformed from airport-local ENU to the USGS export EPSG:3857 crop. Candidate lines are not routing-approved. Legacy approximate geometry remains faint and quarantined.
svg.text: KAUO • ALDOT pavement polygons / USGS NAIP 2023
Red: FAA runway axes • Green: taxiway polygons • Dashes: OSM candidate centerlines (MEDIUM, not routing-approved) • Gold: apron • Gray: quarantined legacy • DATA_BLOCKED
